notes: The prompt is thin but the clarifying answer resolves it outright: a tower climbed like a simple obby, which is Obby & Platformer on course-tower, routing the genre P6 plus P2 because a five-level tower stacks its platforms above each other. Kept the Tower Obby preset but dropped its obstacle-timing, since vanishing and beat-the-clock platforms contradict the answer's request for something simple, and added obstacle-jump for the plain jumps that leaves. With no user to ask I assumed a checkpoint at each of the five levels so a fall costs one level rather than the whole tower, and read the top of the tower as the winner-zone payoff. Avatar in the prompt is the Roblox character doing the climbing rather than a dress-up or display feature, so this is not Roleplay & Avatar Sim.
